verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line in the enterprise overview listing "regional code hosting" among enterprise features. It appears limited to enterprise plans and refers to code, not clearly to the app database or user data held in the Lovable Cloud backend. missing for 10: documented user-selectable region for the Cloud database and storage, residency options outside enterprise plans, details of available regions and how to choose them, independent or hands-on corroboration.
